name: Taplio
summary: LinkedIn growth tool for finding post ideas, writing in your voice, scheduling and lead generation.
description: Taplio is built for LinkedIn. It surfaces popular posts for inspiration, writes drafts in the user's voice, schedules posts at optimal times, analyses performance and automates connection requests and DMs to warm leads. It is also available as a Claude connector and through MCP. Plans start at $39 per month with a free trial and a money-back guarantee. Full app access is included during the trial whichever plan is chosen.
